candidates.returns: Distance of the point of interest from the camera

anomalies: members_total=32 exactly matches _overview.md's declared 19 properties + 13 methods, so there are no ghost pages and no pages missing from the directory; all 32 pages carry a **Signature** line, hence no_signature_pages=0.

The literal string 'in-process, unmanaged C++' occurs zero times anywhere in this family, so pointer_returns=0 and pointer_params_only=0 are both vacuous counts rather than evidence that the family has no pointer members.

Despite that zero, five members return interface objects described only in prose (GetPosition/GetUpVector/GetViewVector say 'Pointer to ...'/'Point to ...', RotationRollEntity and TargetPointPosition return System.object/MathPoint), so this family expresses pointer-ness without the standard official marker.

Criterion E's 'non-pointer' qualifier had to be read as 'does not carry the official in-process marker', which gives zero_arg_methods=5; if pointer-interface return types (MathPoint/MathVector) were instead excluded, the count would be 2 (GetFocalDistance, GetPointOfInterestDistance) - the ambiguity is recorded rather than silently resolved.

SetPositionSpherical.md carries a '## Returns' section even though its signature returns void, and its Returns text 'Latitude about target' is verbatim the description of parameter A2, a documentation defect that makes Returns sections unreliable as evidence in this family.

Seven property pages assert 'This property is a get-only property. Set is not implemented' yet still print '{get; set;}' in their Signature (AspectRatio, DepthOfFieldEnabled, DepthOfFieldOffset, FieldOfViewAngle, FieldOfViewDepth, FieldOfViewHeight, Perspective); all seven are still counted in properties_no_paren because the criterion keys on the signature form only.

Six method pages have no '## Returns' section at all (GetPositionCartesian, GetPositionSpherical, SetPositionCartesian, SetPositionEntity, SetPositionSpherical, SetTargetPointEntity); all six are void-returning and therefore fall outside every counted criterion.
SetPositionSpherical.md's See Also contains a doubled prefix typo, '[[ICamera::ICamera::PositionType Property]]'.
Perspective.md's C# example link points at Insert_Cavity_Example_CSharp.md instead of Insert_Camera_Example_CSharp.md, while its VB.NET and VBA links correctly point at the camera example.

FieldOfViewAngle.md is the only member stating its unit (radians) in the Returns text; its siblings FieldOfViewDepth and FieldOfViewHeight give no unit, and that gap cannot be resolved from this corpus, so it was left un-inferred.
